reason: 该插件的主要用途是面向用户提供一个 DSH Web 的日历与待办统一操作界面：通过侧边栏进入的专属面板管理任务、日程、外部日历同步，并可在对话中用工具执行查询、增删改。证据来自 README 对场景布局、数据文件绑定和 agent 工具能力的明确说明，结合 package.json 的客户端插件声明，表明其属于界面化日历/待办插件而非代码生成或分析类插件。

summaries.zh: DSH Web 插件，提供基于文件夹的数据隔离日历与待办管理面板，支持时间轴浏览、快速增删改任务，并可通过对话工具结合外部 iCal/Google 日历实现同步与提醒。
summaries.en: A DSH Web plugin that provides a folder-scoped calendar and todo management panel, supports timeline-based organization and quick task/event editing, and integrates with external iCal/Google calendars through conversation tools with reminders.

capabilities: Per-folder local data storage and migration
Calendar/todo CRUD exposed through conversation tools
Timeline and quick-entry UI for task/event management
Session-bound reminder delivery and Telegram notification path
Time-based reminder scheduling and recurrence-aware expansion logic

reasons.code: README describes a DSH web plugin for calendar + todo with per-folder data root (`dsh-calendar-todo.json`) and workspace-bound migration/sync behavior.
README lists agent tools `calendar_todo_query/add/add_event/update/delete` that can create, query, modify, and delete todos/events from conversation.
README documents external calendar configuration, ICS fetching, recurrence handling, sync intervals, and automatic reminders, including Telegram message delivery through `telegramBridge`.
Package metadata declares integration with DSH web client hooks and bundle patching (`dsh` client inject slots/workspaces/sessions/locale), indicating UI extension and tool wiring.
